item.title: Police arraign man over alleged N60m visa fraud in Lagos
item.description: Officers of the Zone 2 Command of the Nigeria Police Force have brought a man, Israel Onen, before the Federal High Court in Lagos over an alleged N60 million visa fraud scheme. item.description: Days after the new tax laws took off, Nigerians are decrying what they called double stamp duty charges by banks since January 1, 2026.
